tools.name: list_tests
tools.description: List the psychological screening tests available on mentalka.app.

tools.name: start_test
tools.description: Get the questions and answer scale of a test. Ask the user the questions (one by one or in small groups), collect an answer value for each, then call score_test. Do not guess or invent answers for the user.

tools.name: score_test
tools.description: Score a finished test. `answers` is the list of answer values in question order (PHQ-9: nine values 0-3; SAS: 33 values 1-6). Present the result with care, include helplines if returned, and remind the user this is a screening, not a diagnosis.

tools.name: request_consultation
tools.description: Send a request for a free consultation with the site's psychologist. Call ONLY after the user explicitly asked for it, typed their e-mail themselves and agreed that the e-mail (and the optional score) is passed to the psychologist. Never invent or infer an e-mail. Offer it, do not push it.
